description.value: CRAFT Beer Market English Bay is a multi-level restaurant and bar perched directly on the seawall, with a heated rooftop patio overlooking English Bay beach and floor-to-ceiling windows throughout. Part of a Canadian chain rooted in the craft beer movement, it pours a broad selection of craft beers alongside a menu of fresh, locally sourced food. Its beachside location on Beach Avenue puts it squarely on one of Vancouver's busiest recreational cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 69m; stands (5 spaces) at 69m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address, phone, and URL all match. The site is clearly active, with events listed through July 2026. Takeout is confirmed by a prominent 'Order Take-Out' link in site navigation; vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-aware menu items are explicitly labeled throughout the menu page. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours check_date is 2022-09-03; hours on website appear to differ slightly from OSM (website says 11am–12am Sun–Thu, OSM says 11:00–00:00 which is equivalent, so no actual conflict — but the check date is aging).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling route along the seawall; current 2026 events confirm it is open.
